name: fleet-infra
description: claude-fleet for the people who run the machines and the hub: runbooks as skills — prepare a Mac, enroll it, open and delete logins, a cloud Linux node, an overseas relay, deploy the hub. Each says when to use it, what to check first, the steps, how to verify, how to roll back. Admins only: never installed by default, never handed out by the hub (EPIC #3569).
